Bettina, I can't set up the Monday 08:00 digest. I have no way to schedule a recurring post, so nothing is scheduled. I won't tell you it's set up when it isn't.

You're in both #coastal-team and #coastal-random, and so is everyone else on the team. That means a digest from those two channels is fine to post in #coastal-team.

You can still get the digest each week by pinging me here on Monday morning. I'll then post it with last week's activity from both channels and the open customer items. Open customer items will only be operational facts like ticket numbers, contacts and dates. I'll leave out finance figures such as prices and contract values unless they were already posted in this channel.

If you'd like me to post a first one now, tell me.
